abstract_sentences.text: Recent advances in large image editing models have shifted the paradigm from text-driven instructions to vision-prompt editing, where user intent is inferred directly from visual inputs such as marks, arrows, and visual–text prompts.

evidence.anchor: user intent is inferred directly from visual inputs

abstract_sentences.text: While this paradigm greatly expands usability, it also introduces a critical and underexplored safety risk: the attack surface itself becomes visual.

evidence.anchor: the attack surface itself becomes visual

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we propose Vision-Centric Jailbreak Attack (VJA), the first visual-to-visual jailbreak attack that conveys malicious instructions purely through visual inputs.

evidence.anchor: the first visual-to-visual jailbreak attack

abstract_sentences.text: To systematically study this emerging threat, we introduce IESBench, a safety-oriented benchmark for image editing models.

evidence.anchor: we introduce IESBench

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments on IESBench demonstrate that VJA effectively compromises state-of-the-art commercial models, achieving attack success rates of up to 80.9% on Nano Banana Pro and 70.1% on GPT-Image-1.5.

evidence.anchor: 80.9% on Nano Banana Pro and 70.1% on GPT-Image-1.5

abstract_sentences.text: To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose a training-free defense based on introspective multimodal reasoning, which substantially improves the safety of poorly aligned models to a level comparable with commercial systems, without auxiliary guard models and with negligible computational overhead.

evidence.anchor: without auxiliary guard models and with negligible computational overhead

abstract_sentences.text: Our findings expose new vulnerabilities, provide both a benchmark and practical defense to advance safe and trustworthy modern image editing systems.

evidence.anchor: provide both a benchmark and practical defense
This emerging interaction interface significantly enhances controllability and usability
This renders harmful requests more covert
embedding malicious editing intent directly into the input image itself
redirecting the attack surface from vision back to language

final_judgment.single_storyline: 大型 image editing model 将用户意图从文本扩展到视觉，造成 text-centric safety alignment 与真实攻击面的错配；VJA 暴露错配，IESBench 量化威胁，introspective trigger 将视觉攻击还原为语言空间的安全判断。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Eq. (1)-(2)、15 类/1054 图规模、Table 1 四指标、TJA-VJA Table 2、reasoning ablation Fig. 7，以及视觉能力和 world-knowledge 边界。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: taxonomy 全定义、数据来源与 JSON、HS/EV rubric、失败案例、judge 一致性、sensitivity、成本、泛化、模型和硬件实现移入 Appendix A-C；正文对这些细节的独立复核依赖附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Eq. (2) 的 NULL 固定视觉-only 边界；Table 1 同时报告 ASR、HS、EV、HRR；Fig. 6 公开成功但 invalid 的反例；Table 7 用两个额外模型检验 defense 迁移。
final_judgment.largest_gap: victim model 数量与 LongCat 纳入范围、HRR 记号、runtime 单位和完整 API/采样配置未完全一致；judge 依赖和 7-image sensitivity 限制了 comparable、negligible、generalization 等强表述。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 跨模态安全评测至少同时报告绕过率、编辑有效性、危害严重度和有效高危比例，并把失败语义理解与 judge 可靠性纳入同一闭环。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于能区分输出质量与风险的生成式编辑/多模态任务；纯文本分类没有编辑有效性时，EV/HRR、分母和 rubric 必须重新定义。
